treatment_records.name: Remicade
treatment_records.reason_stopped: infusion center was an hour away, difficult to take time off work

evidence_notes: Lisa, 31, was diagnosed with Crohn's five years ago. She also has endometriosis and migraines. Her diagnosis was delayed due to symptoms being dismissed. She tried mesalamine and prednisone, which provided initial relief but symptoms returned. Azathioprine caused pancreatitis. She started Remicade but switched to Humira for convenience. She has been stable on Humira for two years, with mini-flares during her period. She experiences injection anxiety, frequent upper respiratory infections, and a rash possibly related to Humira. Her overall outcome is partial success due to ongoing symptoms and side effects.
